execution_cost_interpretation.cx_world_counts: Completed replay worlds independently counted from known/unknown retained receipts; a separate full-hold preflight world is recorded per engine trial.
execution_cost_interpretation.fresh_policy_calls: Independently recomputed from retained factual decisions and resampled reply receipts; includes factual plus continuation calls.
execution_cost_interpretation.native_glue_counts: Aggregated recorded deterministic prefix-reconstruction/probe counters, not fresh stochastic policy calls; full glue event histories are not retained.
execution_cost_interpretation.timing: Sum of trial elapsed times includes adapter glue and concurrent worker contention. This is not serial duration or an intrinsic speed comparison.

limitations: In-progress files are provisional until a terminal manifest or incomplete receipt exists.
Simulator/policy/transport compatibility and conditional calibration, not independent tasks or method superiority.

Intervals are read from recorded engine outputs; this audit independently computes points, coverage, error and widths.

Native CAR budget-control contrastive batches coalesce 31 or32 zero-spend refusal records under one failed canonical slot. Native failed/unstarted slot labels do not provide a one-to-one refused-attempt inventory, and these trials have no primary numeric estimates.
